title: Unequal by age and household type: income inequality and demographic aging in central and eastern europe
core_idea: Investigates how demographic aging relates to income inequality across age groups and household types in Central and Eastern European states between 2005 and 2022, comparing liberal and corporatist post-socialist welfare typologies using EU-SILC data and framed by a neo-familial perspective.
tldr: Analyzes the relationship between demographic aging and income inequality by age and household type in CEE countries (2005 vs 2022), contrasting liberal and corporatist post-socialist welfare models using EU-SILC and a family-centered lens.
